source: SPM Essay on Travelling Local (Travel folder, .docx)
paragraphs: Travelling locally has become a popular option for many people, especially in recent years. Exploring one’s own country offers unique experiences and opportunities to discover hidden gems close to home. Personally, I enjoy travelling locally because it allows me to appreciate the beauty and diversity of my country without the stress of long-distance travel.

One local destination in Malaysia that should not be missed is Langkawi. Known as the “Jewel of Kedah,” Langkawi is a stunning island with beautiful beaches, clear waters, and lush greenery. Besides relaxing by the sea, visitors can explore the Langkawi Sky Bridge, visit the famous Langkawi Cable Car, and enjoy duty-free shopping. It’s a perfect destination for nature lovers and adventure seekers alike.

Travelling locally has several advantages compared to going abroad. First, it is often more affordable as you save on expensive flight tickets and avoid currency exchange rates. Second, it’s easier to plan a trip locally since there are fewer visa or language barriers to worry about. Finally, travelling within your own country supports the local economy and helps small businesses thrive.

To fully enjoy a local trip, plan your itinerary carefully to explore places off the beaten path. Try local food and engage with the culture to make the experience richer. Travelling during off-peak seasons can also help you avoid crowds and get better deals on accommodation. Packing lightly and being open to new experiences will make your journey more enjoyable.

In conclusion, travelling locally offers a wonderful opportunity to discover new destinations, save money, and support your community. Whether it’s a short weekend getaway or a longer trip, exploring your own country can be just as exciting as going abroad, if not more rewarding.
